firstPlayerRule: With three to six players, whoever most recently saw a rabbit leads the first trick in Chapter II. With two players, agree who will lead that first trick.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Chapter I begins with simultaneous card choices. This starting instruction applies to the trick-taking chapter that follows.
The rabbit criterion belongs to the three-to-six-player rules; the two-player section gives its own instruction.
